caseName: In re Discipline of La Quetta Maria Golden
caseNameFull: In the Matter of Discipline of La Quetta Maria Golden

opinions.text: La Quetta Maria Golden, of Gulfport, Mississippi, is suspended from the practice of law in this Court, and a rule will issue, returnable *1131within 40 days, requiring her to show cause why she should not be disbarred from the practice of law in this Court.
